verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an inference/training platform, since vendors in this category could offer on-prem or bring-your-own-cloud deployments. Every piece of evidence here describes Fireworks as a managed service: clients point at api.fireworks.ai, and Fireworks runs the GPUs on its own global fleet. The open-source benchmarking tool, custom-model uploads and keeping fine-tuned weights are adjacent features, not a self-hostable core product.
